description: This file defines the ZendeskHelpProcessor class in the OrangeHRM Help module, responsible for interacting with Zendesk's help center API. It primarily constructs URLs for searching help articles, fetches search results via HTTP requests, and determines redirect URLs based on search outcomes.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: Implements the HelpProcessor interface to provide integration with Zendesk Help Center API, handling search URL construction and redirection logic.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HelpConfigService instance providing configuration data for help URLs.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an HTTP client instance for making requests to Zendesk API.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the help system from the configuration service.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs a Zendesk search URL with the specified label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Uses the search URL to find the first relevant article and returns its URL, or default URL if none found.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the provided URL with specified content type, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default help URL for redirection.
